::: {.mx-lg-3}
[Hi, my name is Mel --- ]{.text-serif .text-muted .me-2 style="font-size:1.75em;"} I am an [Applied Economist]{.mark} turned [Geospatial Data Scientist]{.mark} (yes, around that time when global model simulations required distributed loads) -- I am passionate about ZERO nonsense, equitable and sustainable policy making that truly empowers everyone's life in full respect of planetary boundaries.

As a [consultant]{.mark}, [designer]{.mark}, and [instructor]{.mark}, I specialize in helping research teams and businesses effectively harness data, build  models, and communicate insights through engaging stories and visuals

I code mostly in [R]{.mark}, [Python]{.mark}, [JavaScript]{.mark} and [D3.js]{.mark}. Check out my full bio for contact details.
:::
